basin_classes.name: Stable Local Basin
basin_classes.definition: Repeated local Pi_A application preserves admissible image membership without activating preserved blockers.
basin_classes.theorem_use: May support restricted local proof steps only.

basin_classes.name: Metastable Local Basin
basin_classes.definition: Pi_A application remains locally admissible for finite recursion depth but becomes threshold-sensitive under perturbation.
basin_classes.theorem_use: May support bounded evidence, not proof closure.

basin_classes.name: Oscillatory Basin
basin_classes.definition: Repeated projection cycles among admissible or near-admissible images without settling into stable idempotent persistence.

basin_classes.name: Topology-Severed Basin
basin_classes.definition: Continuation structure disconnects or loses boundary accessibility under recursive pressure.

basin_classes.name: Identity-Ambiguous Basin
basin_classes.definition: Admissibility image persists locally but identity trace cannot be uniquely reconstructed.
